title: Data Roles and Responsibilities
objective: Study-guide review — CISSP — Domain 2: Asset Security: Data Roles and Responsibilities.

items: Data Owner — Senior management; accountable for data protection and classification
Data Controller (GDPR) — Determines purposes and means of processing personal data
Owners define who can access data and under what conditions
Owners are ultimately accountable for asset protection
Classification decisions are the Owner's responsibility
Data Owner/Controller — Accountable for protection of data; holds legal rights and defines access requirements; identifies classification; decides who has access with what types of privileges

blocks.text: From Destination CISSP: "Owners are ultimately accountable for an asset and protecting its value. Owners should understand the importance of following governance mandates and the need to classify each asset they're accountable for." Data Owners must:

items: Define classification levels for their data
Approve access requests
Define retention and destruction requirements
Assist in identification and assessment of security controls
Be involved in risk assessment for their data
Data Custodian — IT staff; implements and maintains controls per Owner's direction
Data Processor (GDPR) — Processes data on behalf of the Controller
Custodians handle day-to-day data management (backups, storage, access control)
Custodians do NOT make classification decisions
Processors must follow Controller's instructions for data handling

blocks.text: From Official CBK: The Data Custodian is responsible for:

items: Implementing security controls specified by the Owner
Performing regular backups and restoration testing
Managing data storage infrastructure
Ensuring data integrity through technical means
Verifying security requirements and security controls for information systems

blocks.text: GDPR-specific: Under GDPR, the Data Processor must:

items: Process data only as instructed by the Controller
Implement appropriate technical and organizational measures
Notify the Controller of any data breach without undue delay
Delete or return all personal data at end of processing relationship
Data Steward — Business responsibility for data quality, metadata, governance, compliance
Data Subject — Individual to whom personal data pertains
System Owner — Responsible for the system hosting the data
Stewards ensure data quality and consistency across the organization
Subjects have rights under privacy laws (access, correction, deletion)
Data Steward — Business responsibility for data (metadata definition, data quality, governance, compliance)
Data Subject — Individual to whom personal data pertains

blocks.text: Under GDPR, Data Subjects have rights including:

items: Right of access (view their data)
Right to rectification (correct errors)
Right to erasure ("right to be forgotten")
Right to data portability
Right to object to processing
Right not to be subject to automated decision-making
